subject: Re: BrightCart checkout blip — credit path & RCA scheduling
messages:
From: Sara Hughes <sara.hughes@brightcart.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@brightcart.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 22:15:00 -0000
Subject: BrightCart checkout blip (2027-04-02 18:40-19:10 UTC) — request for credit and logs

Hi Naomi,

We saw a checkout failure window on our BrightCart tenant today between ~18:40 and 19:10 UTC (approx 30 mins). During the window our customers got a higher-than-usual 5xx rate and some checkout sessions failed to complete — revenue impact for a handful of merchants. Our telemetry shows retries and increased latency when calling Redwood's /generate endpoint for our checkout summarization flow.

We've attached a small telemetry bundle and an initial impact worksheet. Can you confirm if this window is eligible for SLA credit and share the next steps for an RCA? Our procurement/legal team will want an official confirmation and a short postmortem for our records.

Attached: brightcart_telemetry_20270402.tar.gz, request_for_credit_form.pdf

Thanks,
Sara Hughes
Head of Ops, BrightCart
--
BrightCart | https://brightcart.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Sara Hughes <sara.hughes@brightcart.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 02:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: BrightCart checkout blip (2027-04-02 18:40-19:10 UTC) — request for credit and logs

Hi Sara — thanks for the bundle and the heads up. We pulled preliminary traces against the timestamps you supplied and can see elevated 500/502 responses from our edge pool in us-west-2 right around 18:48–19:02 UTC.

Quick notes / next steps:
- We will run a full evidence pull (traces, traceroutes, routing logs, autoscaler events) and deliver a raw log bundle by EOD Monday (2027-04-05).
- To assess SLA credit eligibility we need to run the adjudication: confirm exact impacted tenant UUID, verify whether the incident meets the "Unscheduled Availability" SLO threshold, and whether a protected maintenance/exemption applies.
- Can you confirm the exact tenant_id and the highest-severity impact customers (merchant ids) so we can correlate? That will speed the review.

I’m looping Diego (platform infra) and Karthik (SRE) to scope the evidence pull and timeline. We’ll also schedule a short postmortem call — propose Tue 2027-04-06 16:00 UTC (we have a 30-min slot). If that works for you we’ll send a calendar invite.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Technical Account Director | Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: BrightCart checkout blip (2027-04-02 18:40-19:10 UTC) — request for credit and logs

Sara / Naomi — quick technical summary from the initial pass:
- Observed elevated 5xxs were concentrated on a subset of inference hosts behind an edge router in us-west-2.
- Autoscaler events show a spike in queued requests at 18:47 followed by a short allocation delay; there was a known control-plane throttling spike in a dependent indexing subsystem at 18:46 that affected kernel scheduling for ~6 minutes.
- We need your tenant_id to produce a tenant-scoped trace bundle (the attached customer bundle is anonymized).

Sara, if you can send tenant_id and sample merchant_ids we will:
1) Produce a tenant-scoped log bundle (traces + host metrics + autoscaler events) for the exact window.
2) Run the SLA eligibility adjudication and provide a preliminary determination in the postmortem call.

Thanks — Diego
Diego Fernandez
Senior Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference

Sara — got it, thanks. Attachments received.

Meeting: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 16:00–16:30 UTC — "BrightCart incident 2027-04-02: RCA & SLA adjudication" (calendar invite sent).
Deliverables we’ll bring to the call:
- Tenant-scoped raw log bundle (traces + host metrics + autoscaler timeline) — link will be shared in the invite.
- Preliminary credit eligibility assessment (we expect to have a recommendation: full credit / pro-rata / not-eligible) based on the SLO rulebook and observed outage window.
- Short slide (2 slides): chronology + immediate remediation plan and longer-term mitigations.

If at the call we confirm credit eligibility we will follow the documented credit path (procurement form + engineering signoff) and target issuing a formal credit statement within 5 business days. If we determine the event is due to a protected control-plane maintenance or customer-side misconfig, we’ll explain the rationale in the postmortem.

Thanks — Naomi
